claims.summary: Direct provider CourseIR acceptance now rejects CourseIR that required structural repair before validation.
The same under-assessed CourseIR can still repair before deterministic compiler rendering, preserving the pre-DOCX/PPTX safety net.
Direct-authoring acceptance now reports repairedBeforeAcceptance and includes repair codes in the rejection reason.
Regression coverage proves repaired broad-assessment CourseIR is rejected for direct authoring while still compiling after repair with zero provider calls.
The roadmap documents why compiler repair and accepted direct authoring must remain separate proof claims.

carryForward.next: Strengthen provider prompts and genome coverage so direct CourseIR returns per-lesson assessment and rubric atoms without repair.
